texts.zh:
最后一只变异工蜂被击败了。我们的通讯工蜂再一次探测到了另一个意识的存在，但现在它变得更加地温顺，等待着我们启动通讯。

“我们对此表示歉意：随着虚无的逼近，本能反应已经越来越难以压制了。我们保证在未来会严加管束自己。”
texts.en:
The final divergent drone has been defeated. Our communication drones are once again detecting the presence of the other Overmind, but it's acting a lot submissively this time, waiting for us to initiate communication.

"This Mind apologises - instinctive reactions are getting harder to suppress as The Static nears. We will ensure that we restrain ourselves in the future."

texts.zh:
叛乱的繁育单元被击败了。我们的观测分析子例程再次探测到了来自[FromFrom.GetName]贝塔的通讯单元。他们只留下了一条简单的讯息。

“多余的防御单元再一次以非最佳方式行动。随着虚无的迫近，它们成功地突破了我们的隔离措施。这个进程已经被删除了，不会再有进一步的行为。”
texts.en:
The rebelling defense unit has been defeated. Our observation analysis subroutines are once again detecting the presence of [FromFrom.GetName]-Beta's communication units. They left us with a simple message.

"Once again redundant defense units have acted in sub-optimal ways. As the The Static approaches, they managed to get through our quarantining efforts. The processes have since been deleted and should not take any further action."

label.zh: 我们会检查是否属实的。
label.en: We will make sure that you do.

tooltips.zh: 以我们的数量优势抑制贝塔世界蜂巢思维的存在。
tooltips.en: Suppress the presence of the Beta-World hive mind through our superior numbers.

tooltips.zh: 确保另一个次元不会再有通往[FromFrom.GetName]的不安全链接。
tooltips.en: Ensure that the other dimension does not have any more unsecured connections to [FromFrom.GetName].

label.zh: 可以理解，战斗AI天然就有破坏性。
label.en: Understandable, combat AI is subversive by nature.
